official_title.value: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Bimekizumab in Study Participants With Moderate to Severe Hidradenitis Suppurativa

mechanism_of_action.source_excerpt: openFDA drug/label mechanism_of_action (FDA-approved label, section 12.1) -- v1 extracted text: 12.1 Mechanism of Action Bimekizumab-bkzx is a humanized immunoglobulin IgG1/ κ monoclonal antibody with two identical antigen binding regions that selectively bind to human interleukin 17A (IL-17A), interleukin 17F (IL-17F), and interleukin 17-AF cytokines, and inhibits their interaction with the IL-17 receptor complex. IL-17A and IL-17F are naturally occurring cytokines that are involved in normal inflammatory and immune responses. Bimekizumab-bkzx inhibits the release of proinflammatory cytokines and chemokines.

background_therapy.source_excerpt: Section 6.5.1 Permitted concomitant treatments: 'Wound care: Concomitant use of wound care dressings on HS wounds is allowed; however, options are limited to alginates, hydrocolloids, and hydrogels... Lesion care: Concomitant use of saline, water, and/or Vaseline (petroleum jelly) is allowed... Analgesic therapy: Study participants will be required to wash out of all analgesics for HS-related pain 14 days prior to Baseline. However, if a study participant is on a stable (scheduled) dose of a non-opioid analgesic... the study participant may continue the analgesic... Antibiotic therapy: For study participants entering the study in the antibiotic strata, they should be on a stable dose and regimen of doxycycline, minocycline, or an equivalent systemic tetracycline for 28 days prior to Baseline.' Section 6.5.2 Prohibited concomitant treatments: 'All biologic therapy with a potential therapeutic impact on the disease being studied... Phototherapy... Immunomodulatory therapy, including topical or systemic steroids except as noted in Section 6.5.3.1... Topical and systemic therapies for HS...'

multiplicity_control.source_excerpt: This trial's own protocol PDF text: 'To control the overall type I error rate at 0.05 for the multiple comparisons in the primary and secondary efficacy variables, a closed testing procedure under a parallel gatekeeping framework will be applied (Sun, 2018). Under this framework, each bimekizumab dose of [redacted] and [redacted] will be compared to placebo in the first instance at a familywise error rate of 0.025 (alpha/2)... Step 1: Test HiSCR50 at significance level 0.025. Steps 2 to 5 - If Step 1 is significant at 0.025 then test each secondary endpoint sequentially in the order shown below... In the event that Step 5 is significant at 0.025 for a given dose, then Steps 1 to 5 will be repeated for the other dose using a significance level of 0.05.' Secondary endpoint list (doses also redacted per-item): '1. HiSCR75 at Week 16... 2. Absolute change from Baseline in DLQI Total Score at Week 16... 3. Absolute change from Baseline in Skin Pain Score at Week 16... 4. Pain response... at Week 16.' The specific dose labels (320mg Q2W / 320mg Q4W) are redacted/blank in this trial's own extracted PDF text; they are carried over from the byte-identical passage in sister trial NCT04242446 (HS0003, BE HEARD I), whose corresponding PDF has them unredacted, and both trials share the same randomized 2:2:2:1 bimekizumab dose design per their synopses.

value.dosing_interval: Subcutaneous injection; bimekizumab 320 mg every 2 weeks (Q2W) or every 4 weeks (Q4W) depending on dose regimen/period
value.source_inconsistency: Total study duration is stated as a range: '68 to 71 weeks for those who complete HS0004 and do not participate in the extension study HS0005 and 50 to 53 weeks for those who participate in HS0005' (since HS0005 participants skip the 20-week SFU Period); total_duration_weeks above (70) uses the mid-to-upper end of the non-extension range (5-week screening + 48-week treatment + 20-week follow-up ~= 73, though the protocol's own stated range is 68-71, likely reflecting the 14-35 day screening window rather than a flat 5 weeks). This trial's (HS0004, BE HEARD II) synopsis/duration text is byte-identical to sister trial NCT04242446 (HS0003, BE HEARD I) apart from the protocol number itself, confirmed by direct text comparison of both protocol PDFs.

study_schedule.source_excerpt: Synopsis, 'Treatment Groups and Duration': 'Study participants... will complete a Screening Period of 14 days to up to 5 weeks; a double-blind, 48-week Treatment Period comprising a 16-week Initial Treatment Period and 32-week Maintenance Treatment Period; and a 20-week Safety Follow-up (SFU) Period following the final injection of investigational medicinal product (IMP) if study participants do not enter a subsequent extension study (HS0005) or withdraw prematurely from treatment. The total duration of study participation in HS0004 will be 68 to 71 weeks for those who complete HS0004 and do not participate in the extension study HS0005 and 50 to 53 weeks for those who participate in HS0005... Study participants will be randomized in a 2:2:2:1 ratio... to 1 of 3 dose regimens of bimekizumab or placebo... The primary efficacy variable at Week 16 is HiSCR50.' Section 4.1.1/4.1.2 headers confirm 'Screening Period (Weeks -5 to 0)' and 'Initial Treatment Period (Weeks 0-16) and Maintenance Treatment Period (Weeks 16-48)'.

value.applies_to_period: Initial Treatment Period (Weeks 0-16) and Maintenance Treatment Period (Weeks 16-48)
value.rationale: Section 6.5.3 Rescue medication: 'The Sponsor will not supply rescue medication.' Section 6.5.3.1 Antibiotic Rescue Medication/Antibiotics: 'Any systemic antibiotic that is initiated (new antibiotic or change in the dose/type of current antibiotic) on or after Baseline (first day of study drug administration) will be considered rescue medication for both the Initial Treatment Period and Maintenance Treatment Period.' Section 6.5.3.2 Rescue Medications/Lesion Intervention: 'There are no absolute restrictions on the use of rescue medications for study participants whose HS deteriorates during the study... Investigators will have the option to perform interventions. Interventions can include analgesics for a limited period of time, intralesional injections of triamcinolone, and/or incision and drainage of the abscess... A total of 2 protocol-allowed interventions are permissible during the Initial Treatment Period (from Baseline Visit to Week 16)... If a study participant requires more than 2 interventions within the first 16 weeks of the study, then the study participant should be discontinued from the study. During the Maintenance Treatment Period (Weeks 16 to 48), a maximum of 2 interventions every 4 weeks are permitted... If a study participant requires more than 2 interventions within a 4-week period... then the study participant should be discontinued from the study.'
